datastores.command: docker compose -f deploy/tcdn-ai/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
datastores.note: the repo-root compose stack already held 5432/6379, so its postgres/redis were stopped first; the dev file cannot share those ports with it

coordinator.keyring: in-memory development keyring (as the doc states)

provision.manifest_note: sha256 of the canonical manifest JSON; the echo backend serves no weights, so the hash is real but the artifact is not a signed shard set

sdk.keys: coordinator keys pinned via TOFU (the doc's expected message)

openai_gateway.client: official openai python client, base_url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1

gaps_found: DEV_SETUP has no step to FUND the account: a fresh account fails step 4 with InsufficientCreditsError. Section 2 was followed by crediting 500 credits through the ledger (kind signup_credit) before the SDK call.

DEV_SETUP tells the reader to replace the manifest hash with 'the hash of a manifest you actually signed', but the repo ships no manifest-signing script and the echo backend never verifies one; the run used the sha256 of a real manifest JSON.
